scores.label: A
scores.note: options 2 'peaceful' and 3 'tranquil' lose the meaning of safety and duplicate 'quiet'; options 5-10 are noun phrases that are ungrammatical in place ('one of the only safe haven and quiet places'), and 5 repeats 'safe'

scores.label: B
scores.note: option 3 'reliable' and option 4 'stable' are the wrong meaning; options 5 'peaceful' and 6 'calm' lose the sense of safety and duplicate 'quiet'; option 10 'a sanctuary' is ungrammatical in place; options 8-9 are awkward before 'and quiet'

scores.label: C
scores.note: option 1 'quiet' gives 'quiet and quiet places'; options 2 'peaceful' and 4 'tranquil' lose the sense of safety and duplicate 'quiet'; option 5 'hospitable' is the wrong meaning (welcoming)
